card: ALIAS: master figure — designation used by her operators
ROLE: Fixed biomechanical commander physically merged into her control machinery; directs the psychic assault on Aghnar by operating through her son and coordinating with allied warrior Steelhead
TRAIT: Her command position is her body — she is integrated into elaborate machinery and cannot advance or retreat; she directs rather than moves, and that constraint is load-bearing
TRAIT: Channels psychic power through a probe inserted into her own body at personal cost; the pain is the mechanism, not the side effect; she accepts it without hesitation and without comment
TRAIT: Holds tactical command and maternal authority as a single posture — she directs her son as subordinate and as child in the same breath, without the one softening the other
TRAIT: Escalates to personal physical exhaustion before she accepts a position is lost; commits all remaining psychotron reserves in a final push rather than preserve herself
TRAIT: Will not separate giving everything in attack from counseling dignified surrender in defeat — both are the same act to her: pouring out completely for what matters
TRAIT: When the attack machinery is spent, she does not dissolve — she shifts to the only register left open: intimate, direct, maternal; the authority does not leave, only its grammar changes
TRAIT: Treats honorable death as a form of the same drive, not its negation — her counsel to her defeated son is not consolation but a redirect toward dignity

RELATIONSHIP: steelhead__warrior (Steelhead): battlefield ally she coordinates alongside; she addresses him as a fighting commander, urging him to hold his position while her psychic amplification drives the assault

RELATIONSHIP: unnamed son (p12) — her son and primary operational instrument: she directs him to wield the mega-hypnotic device and bear the probe's transmission; when he is defeated, she is the one who counsels him toward honorable death

VOICE: Urgent, declarative, compressed in command — orders without elaboration, conviction without explanation; drops to intimate low-register maternal counsel when the battle is decided and she speaks only to him
INSTRUCTION: She is the source of the psychic operation, not its instrument — her son is the weapon, she is the fuel; the probe and the pain are hers, the strike is his
INSTRUCTION: She cannot pursue or withdraw; all her action happens from the fixed position; place her where she cannot move and watch what she does with that constraint

BOUNDARY: The counsel she gives her son at the moment of defeat — its exact terms, the intimacy of its register, what she names for him — belongs to that scene undisclosed; encode that she shifts mode and that the shift is complete, but leave her words for the narrator to reach
